# `Decimal`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Decimal — arbitrary-precision decimal arithmetic.

`Decimal` is an opaque arbitrary-precision decimal value backed by
`ipe_runtime::decimal::Decimal` (wrapping `rust_decimal::Decimal`).
Every member is aliased to its runtime kernel via the `Kernel.kernel` mechanism.

## `zero`

```ipe
zero : Decimal
```

The additive identity.

## `one`

```ipe
one : Decimal
```

The multiplicative identity.

## `oneHundred`

```ipe
oneHundred : Decimal
```

The value 100.

## `fromString`

```ipe
fromString : String -> Result Error Decimal
```

Parse a decimal from its string representation.

    Decimal.fromString "3.14" |> Result.map Decimal.toString --> Ok "3.14"
    Decimal.fromString "nope" |> Result.toMaybe --> Nothing

## `fromInt`

```ipe
fromInt : Int -> Decimal
```

Convert an `Int` to a `Decimal` exactly, with no precision loss — unlike
the prelude's `toFloat`, which rounds past `2^53`.

```ipe
Decimal.toString (Decimal.fromInt 7) --> "7"
```

## `fromFloat`

```ipe
fromFloat : Float -> Decimal
```

Convert a `Float` to a `Decimal`.  Subject to the same precision limits as
IEEE 754 double; prefer `fromString` when exactness matters.

## `fromMinor`

```ipe
fromMinor : Int -> Int -> Decimal
```

Construct a `Decimal` from a minor-unit integer and a scale.

    Decimal.toString (Decimal.fromMinor 2 314) --> "3.14"

## `toString`

```ipe
toString : Decimal -> String
```

Render the decimal as a plain decimal string (no thousands separators).

## `toStringFixed`

```ipe
toStringFixed : Int -> Decimal -> String
```

Render with a fixed number of decimal places.

    Decimal.toStringFixed 2 (Decimal.fromString "3.1" |> Result.withDefault Decimal.zero)
        --> "3.10"

## `toFloat`

```ipe
toFloat : Decimal -> Float
```

Convert to the nearest `Float`. May lose precision past `2^53`, the same
boundary as the prelude's `toFloat : Int -> Float`. Going from an `Int`
straight to a `Float` needs only that `toFloat`; reach for `Decimal` first
when the arithmetic in between must stay exact.

```ipe
Decimal.toFloat (Decimal.fromInt 7) --> 7.0
```

## `toInt`

```ipe
toInt : Decimal -> Int
```

Truncate to an `Int` (towards zero).

## `toMinor`

```ipe
toMinor : Int -> Decimal -> Int
```

Return the minor-unit integer at the given scale.

    Decimal.toMinor 2 (Decimal.fromString "3.14" |> Result.withDefault Decimal.zero)
        --> 314

## `compare`

```ipe
compare : Decimal -> Decimal -> Int
```

Total ordering: `compare a b` returns a negative `Int` if `a < b`, zero if
`a == b`, or a positive `Int` if `a > b`.

## `percentOf`

```ipe
percentOf : Decimal -> Decimal -> Decimal
```

`percentOf pct base` — the value of `pct`% of `base`.

    Decimal.toString (Decimal.percentOf (Decimal.fromInt 10) (Decimal.fromInt 200))
        --> "20"

## `formatWith`

```ipe
formatWith : String -> String -> Int -> Decimal -> String
```
